contributions.detail: 11 inked rows sum to EXACTLY 2077.94, which is Form A's printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS and both the cover's line-1 THIS and CUMULATIVE cells (the LAST column is left blank on every cover line - this is the filer's FIRST report of the 2024 cycle, so the period and cumulative scopes COINCIDE; recorded as cumulative per the addendum). SUB-$50 TRAP CHECKED: the cover's line-2 '$50.00 or less' aggregate cells are all BLANK, so line 1 and line1+line2 would give the same figure; line 1 is the anchor used. NOTE the filer itemized two contributions that are NOT over $50 (Jean Goode 35.00 and Clark Layton 50.00, which is exactly $50, not more than $50) and folded them into the 2077.94 line-1 total rather than into the line-2 aggregate. That is the filer's own classification and the gate closes on it exactly - no adjustment made.

expenditures.detail: 19 lines are inked on Form B; ONE of them (band 6: '1-19 | WIX Web Host | Content Advertising | 281.02') is STRUCK OUT by a single horizontal pen line drawn across the whole row, and it is DROPPED. The proof is the arithmetic, not the strike mark: the other 18 rows sum to EXACTLY 1269.15, the printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES and the cover's line-3 THIS and CUMULATIVE cells; including the struck row would give 1550.17 and close nothing. (Corroborating, though not the proof: the identical figure 281.02 appears as contribution line 6 on Form A dated 3-03, so the filer appears to have re-recorded the item on the other schedule.)

No earlier filing by this filer is in this chunk, so no cross-filing cumulative chain could be run; the blank LAST column is itself the filer's statement that this is his first report of the cycle.

escalation_note: 600 dpi column strips: p2 amount col rows 1-11, p2 date+name cols rows 1-11, p3 amount col rows 1-10 and 11-19, p3 date+vendor+purpose cols rows 1-10 and 11-19. 1200 dpi single-cell crops: p2 row 7 amount (heavily overwritten) and p3 rows 17-18 amounts (the 87.00 vs 57.00 glyph). Plus the six geometry-proof crops.
notes: index.csv says 'Chuck Goode' / 'Commission Seat C'; the form's 'Full name of Candidate' reads Chuck Goode and 'Candidate for Office Of' reads 'Washington County Commission' - the SEAT LETTER 'C' IS NOT ON THE DOCUMENT (the form has no seat field). Candidate and office otherwise agree; a county office, in scope. Form generation 2, county-branded, full-colour 'WASHINGTON COUNTY / UTAH' logo, FOUR-line cover. Wholly handwritten in blue ink. Reporting period Beginning 1-1-24, Ending 6-13-24; signed 6-13-24; clerk RECEIVED stamp JUN 13 2024. Privacy: the cover prints the candidate's street address, city/state/ZIP, personal email and phone, and Form A's address column carries full street addresses and ZIPs for every donor - ALL DISCARDED at read time; only the city token is kept where the filer wrote one (rows 1 and 5), and donor_state is blank everywhere because the Form A address column never prints a state on this document. TWO GLYPHS SETTLED BY ARITHMETIC, both escalated to 1200 dpi first: (a) contributions line 7's amount is written over a scribbled-out earlier figure and reads '$6?.98'; the other ten rows sum to 2008.96 against a printed 2077.94, so the cell is 68.98 - kept at low confidence with needs_review. (b) expenditures line 18's leading digit is bistable 8/5 at 200 dpi; at 1200 dpi it is a two-loop crossing stroke matching this filer's 8 in '184.31' and NOT his flat-topped open 5 in '51.21' one row above, and the arithmetic agrees (the other 17 rows sum to 1182.15 against 1269.15, leaving 87.00) as does the semantics (87.00 = 3 x the 29.00 monthly website charge, matching the three-month '4,5,6-09' date cell). CALIBRATION-SPECIMEN CANDIDATE: this filing is a clean single-document example of a struck-out ledger row whose exclusion is proved only by the schedule total, alongside two independent arithmetic glyph resolutions - the exact skill the Rhodes reversal screens for.
